# Mirror of the protect-main ruleset's REQUIRED status checks for main.
#
# GitHub treats a required status check that never reports as permanently
# PENDING, not failed. A required context that no job produces therefore blocks
# every pull request forever, and protect-main has no bypass actors, so not even
# an admin can merge past it — the only recovery is editing the ruleset.
#
# tests/test_required_checks.py fails when this list stops matching the names
# ci.yml generates; scripts/ruleset-drift.sh fails when it stops matching the
# live ruleset. Keep all three in step, and see CONTRIBUTING for the order to
# change them in: renaming a required check wedges the very pull request that
# renames it unless the ruleset is contracted first.
Build package & image
Lint & typecheck
Test (3.11, ubuntu-latest)
Test (3.12, ubuntu-latest)
Test (3.13, macos-latest)
Test (3.13, ubuntu-latest)
